plan.major: Agriculture - Animal Science and Industries Emphasis
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Agriculture - Animal Science and Industries Emphasis (BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Agriculture & Agriculture Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Animal Science (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints Total Credits, BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/15/14/14/16/14/15/16) and the plan to 120. The catalog prints the curriculum as ranges (Agriculture Core 36-37 credits; Animal Science and Industries Emphasis 17-18 credits; curriculum 53-55 credits); the map exercises the catalog's options inside those ranges: the 4-credit chemistry pairing CHEM 1010 + CHEM 1015 (the catalog offers three lecture/lab pairings at 4-5 credits), COMM 4240 Technical Writing (one of the catalog's two writing options), two 2-credit AGSC Major Lower-division Elective rows totalling the catalog's 'Complete Two of the Following (4 Credits)' block (AGSC 2630, AGSC 2640, AGSC 2760, AGSC 2820, AGSC 3760), and two 3-credit AGSC/BIOL Major Upper-division Elective rows totalling 6 credits inside the catalog's 'Complete Two of the Following (6-7 Credits)' block (AGSC 3350, AGSC 4100, AGSC 4250, BIOL 3060, BIOL 3065). The emphasis's fixed courses (AGSC 3150, AGSC 3500, AGSC 3505) are placed by the map as printed. Catalog titles are recorded where the map uses ampersands or shortens them ('Agriculture & Society', 'Animal Genetics & Breeding', 'Feeding & Nutrition of Horses & Livestock'). Per the catalog, major requirements must be completed with a grade of 'C-' or better and courses completed over 10 years ago are not accepted toward this degree.
